name: Convenient Misfire (Grit)
body:
Prerequisite(s): grit class feature or Amateur Gunslinger feat

Benefit(s): As an immediate action, you can cause a firearm to misfire as if the creature attacking with it had rolled a natural one. You cannot affect a creature with this ability if they currently possess more grit points that you do (you check with the GM, based on when you use the ability, before you spend a grit point to perform this deed.) This deed costs 1 grit point to perform.

Special: If you possess the Blastback feat you can cause the creature attacking with it to be subject to both a bull rush and a trip attack as part of the misfire, as if you had hit them with a Blastback though you deal no damage due to their poor stance.
